meta.title: Goh Joo Hin — Corporate Clarity Concept
meta.description: An independent Goh Joo Hin corporate website concept: food, electronics, and health and nutrition businesses with authentic portfolio brands.

notice.heading: Independent design concept
notice.affiliation: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Goh Joo Hin Pte Ltd.

draft.pendingHint: {language} translation draft is pending fluent review and is not yet active on the default English entry.

hero.heading: Good things. Every day. Connected.
hero.lead: Explore Goh Joo Hin’s food, electronics, and health and nutrition businesses.
hero.imageAlt: A Singapore household sharing time together
hero.imageFallback: Official GJH lifestyle photograph unavailable right now. Browse the three divisions below.

businesses.heading: Different needs. One connected business.
businesses.lead: Goh Joo Hin operates across three divisions, serving everyday needs through food, lifestyle electronics, and health and nutrition.

food.heading: Food for everyday life.
food.body: Food and beverage products, from pantry essentials to New Moon’s abalone and nourishment ranges.

electronics.heading: Living, connected.
electronics.body: Consumer electronics and lifestyle products, including distribution for Sony described on GJH’s official brand pages.

health.heading: Care, in the everyday.
health.body: Health and nutrition offerings, including the Borsch Med range of Traditional Chinese Medicine supplements.

brands.heading: Distinct brands. Shared everyday relevance.
brands.lead: Meet selected brands in GJH’s portfolio. Each retains its own identity, products, and story.
brands.assetNote: Original brand photography from GJH’s official website. Brands retain their own identities.
brands.brandFallback: Official brand photograph for {brand} is currently unavailable.

new-moon.body: Abalone, bird’s nest, rice, sauces, and more. A consumer brand managed and distributed by GJH.
new-moon.imageAlt: New Moon logo and official food photograph of a family hotpot

mili.body: A range of canned vegetables, fruits, meats, and seafood for everyday meal preparation.
mili.imageAlt: MILI logo and official photograph of a noodle bowl

gogo.body: Drinks and Potong ice cream, bringing refreshment to everyday occasions.
gogo.imageAlt: GOGO logo and official photograph of friends sharing drinks

partnership.heading: Products need the right connections.
partnership.lead: For brands and business partners, GJH describes a combination of sourcing, warehousing, distribution, and customer service.

sourcing.heading: Sourcing & portfolio
sourcing.body: A business working across food, electronics, and health-related products.

warehousing.heading: Warehousing & distribution
warehousing.body: A regional distribution system described in GJH’s official company profile.

service.heading: Relationships & service
service.body: Working with suppliers and customers, with an emphasis on prompt, reliable service.

story.heading: A small store. A story still unfolding.
story.lead: GJH traces its beginnings to a provision store on Singapore’s Rochor Road in the 1940s.

m1940s.heading: Rochor Road beginnings
m1940s.body: The Goh brothers began with a provision store supplying daily food essentials.

m1959.heading: New Moon’s brand origin
m1959.body: New Moon’s own history dates its first abalone product to 1959.

m1981.heading: MILI joins the story
m1981.body: GJH’s timeline identifies MILI as its second house brand.

m2004.heading: A chapter in health
m2004.body: Borsch Med extends the portfolio into health supplements.

reach.heading: Rooted in Singapore. Connected across the region.
reach.lead: GJH’s company profile describes an Asia Pacific distributor network supported by warehousing and distribution capabilities.
reach.disclaimer: Company-profile references; product availability and distribution terms vary by market.

contact.heading: Your next business conversation starts here.
contact.body: Discuss brand distribution, product enquiries, or a potential partnership with GJH through its official contact channel.
contact.externalNote: Opens the official GJH website in a new tab.
